880-7705-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-7705-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

401-2324-2530-3944.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2324-2530-3944.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Repeat.

2390-6191-7684.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-6191-7684.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

5090-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.

710-6798-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-6798-8207.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

512-1432-2691.easyPrerequisites: Ilysian Caryatid and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1432-2691.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
512-1432-2691.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Ilysian Caryatid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

153-3129-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
You have at least two cards in hand.
153-3129-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Jolrael
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

206-240-2292-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

1558-2097-3257-3875-4231.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Jolene.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

190-3029-3971-7342.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Leyline of Sanctity and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Cast Sky Swallower by paying {3}{U}{U}.
When Sky Swallower enters, it triggers, but you cannot target an opponent as they all have hexproof.
Cast Fractured Identity from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Sky Swallower and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
When each opponent's Sky Swallower enters, they each trigger. Each opponent is forced to target you, as all other players have hexproof, giving you control of all their other permanents.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4460-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2033-3459-5078-6766.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

4452-5507-6871-6879.description:
Cast Inquisitive Puppet by paying {1}.
When Inquisitive Puppet enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, it and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Inquisitve Puppet trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending Inquisitive Puppet as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Inquisitive Puppet by exiling it.
Toph triggers, returning Inquisitve Puppet from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Inquisitive Puppet ability from step 5, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

1379-3814-6871.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat.

539-5256-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1894-5220-6578-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
1894-5220-6578-6900.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

2173-5220-6537-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1085-4053-6797.description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.

38-301-978.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

4484-4871-5643-6709-6798.easyPrerequisites:
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5643-6709-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5643-6709-6798.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1479-4677-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4677-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

56-792-3220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-792-3220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Totentanz and Golgari Germination trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-792-3220-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

2921-4826-5222-6644.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that are untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

372-4681-4890.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Dack's Duplicate.
372-4681-4890.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Dack's Duplicate's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Dack's Duplicate leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Dack's Duplicate from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

440-1339-3188-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-3188-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

570-5137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Faeburrow Elder's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

92-3533-4658.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Doomgape triggers.
Holding priority, activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}.
Resolve the Doomgape trigger, causing you to sacrifice Soul of Eternity and gain life equal to its toughness.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

3661-5147-5220-5683.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1479-3756-5671.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3756-5671.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, The Necrobloom, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and The Necrobloom trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3090-3140-6085.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1636-2438-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2438-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3750-4306-5793.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to red is at least five
3750-4306-5793.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

3124-4186-4279.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
3124-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Savra's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Savra's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Repeat from step 6.

719-4385-4434-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
"Treefolk" chosen with Xenograft.
719-4385-4434-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
When the Sliver enters the battlefield as a Treefolk due to Xenograft, Quickbeam triggers, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1409-2034-2883-3263.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Twisted Sewer-Witch.
1409-2034-2883-3263.description:
Activate Twisted Sewer-Witch by paying {2}, blinking it.
When Twisted Sewer-Witch enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Twisted Sewer-Witch.
Resolve the Twisted Sewer-Witch trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token, and then creating a Wicked Role Aura token attached to each Rat you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {2}.
The Wicked Role token triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.

1061-2506-2963.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
"Human," "Pirate," or "Wizard" chosen with Molten Echoes.
1061-2506-2963.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Timestream Navigator.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
Activate the token Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1339-4050-4616.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4050-4616.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1636-3000-3868.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three untapped creatures.
1636-3000-3868.description:
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2034-2397-2972-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ganax, adding {C}{C}.
Ganax dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Ganax from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Ganax enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1927-2634-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
1927-2634-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the Brass's Bounty copy, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

15-803-1722-4050.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
15-803-1722-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
Laid to Rest triggers, drawing you a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, paying {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.
